description: Open source manufacturing execution system: production planning, job orders on machines, plant calendars and an operator station, self-hosted with Docker Compose and extended with plugins built on MIT SDK packages.
rules: Plugins import only @northmes/sdk, @northmes/web-sdk, @northmes/contracts and module contracts packages such as @northmes/planning-contracts, never the AGPL application code.
Secrets come from secret files only; never put a secret in .env, northmes.config.json or compose.yaml.
